messages:
elena: Found unexpected .enc files in a partner ingestion snapshot we grabbed for repro: partner-snapshot-2026-03-22.tar.gz. Looks like KMS-wrapped artifacts (headers included). We need containment + rotation plan.
naveen: can you paste the KMS header (no ciphertext) and filepaths?
elena: header sample: `alg=AES-GCM; key_name=projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/partner-prod-key; wrapped=true`. Affected files: docs/secrets/db_pw.enc, integrator/api_keys.enc, exports/user_cache.enc.
pat: immediate steps: 1) identify principals with IAM on that cryptoKey 2) check Cloud Audit Decrypt/Encrypt/AsymmetricDecrypt calls 3) locate any Vault wrapping operations that could have emitted these blobs.
infra_bot: automation: scheduled audit-export job on key `partner-prod-key` for last 180d. ETA 3m.
sec_bot: Alert created: SEC-2026-03-22-PARTNER-ENC-BLOBS. Assigned @elena @naveen. Triage checklist auto-populated.
oncall_ops: also search backup pipeline logs: which job wrote `partner-snapshot-2026-03-22.tar.gz` and which token/role did it use? If it's an infra automation, we need to rotate that token.
elena: backup manifest shows writer role: `backup-writer-role` and service account `partner-backup-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. That SA has cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and also Vault access via role-id `backup-flow`.
naveen: export IAM: two serviceAccounts have encryption perms: partner-backup-sa and legacy-exporter@redwood-legacy.iam.gserviceaccount.com. legacy-exporter still around from 2023 flows.
pat: legacy-exporter is high risk. Plan: create new key `partner-prod-key-rot1`, rewrap our artifacts to it, revoke legacy-exporter binding, rotate any Vault wrap keys/tokens, and add alerting for Decrypt ops on partner keys. Also run grep across recent snapshots (180d) for `\.enc` patterns and KMS headers.
elena: agreed. Important note: we cannot force partner to rewrap copies they hold. Need contract/path: notify partner with recommended rotation and require attestation.
oncall_ops: prepping token rotations: once binding revoked I'll rotate any CI tokens associated with legacy-exporter and rotate Vault role-id bound to `backup-flow`.
infra_bot: created target key partner-prod-key-rot1. Rewrap dry-run script started: `python infra/rewrap.py --src partner-prod-key --dst partner-prod-key-rot1 --gs-path gs://partner-backups/ --dry-run`.
sec_bot: please attach artifacts to ticket SEC-2026-03-22-PARTNER-ENC-BLOBS: manifest list, IAM policy export, audit grep output, rewrap runbook link.
pat: audit grep initial: 7 Decrypt entries in 90d; 5 from partner-backup-sa internal range, 2 from legacy-exporter within build infra. no external principals.
elena: ok lower immediate compromise risk, but legacy-exporter access is unacceptable. I'll open a PR to tighten IAM and require `principals` pinned for crypto keys. Also add a pre-commit check to block committing scripts that embed wrapped blobs into backups.
naveen: dry-run rewrap had no errors. scheduling live rewrap for 02:00 UTC (low traffic). I'll post success/failure here.
oncall_ops: once rewrap completes I'll rotate Vault wrapping key and rotate any short-lived tokens for backup pipeline. If revoke causes failures, rollback plan: re-add legacy-exporter binding for 10 minutes while we reproduce and fix.
pat: add monitoring: alert on any Decrypt from non-whitelisted IP ranges and Decrypt counts spike >10/hour for that key. Also push long-term audit exports to cold storage for 365d retention.
elena: I've drafted partner notification email and legal cc. We recommend rotation and ask partner to confirm whether they ever stored unwrapped artifacts.
naveen: running inventory across backups: found 3 more snapshots with similar headers in past 120d. adding to ticket.
sec_bot: Postmortem scheduled: 2026-03-23T15:00Z. Checklist: inventory, rewrap, revoke, rotate, partner-notify, RBAC tighten, monitoring.
elena: thanks team. will update ticket after rewrap window. Closing interim thread. :white_check_mark:
